title: Storm Sorceress
description: A blue-haired sorceress with glowing tattoos floats above a massive oceanic vortex, wielding a glowing staff while commanding a swirling waterspout containing ethereal white figures. Below, two old sailing ships are tossed in a turbulent, stormy sea under dark, lightning-filled clouds and a glowing circular portal in the sky.
prompt: A powerful blue-haired sorceress with glowing blue tattoos and flowing white and blue robes floats dramatically above a massive swirling waterspout in a stormy ocean, holding a glowing magical staff with an orb of light, her long hair and clothing billowing in the wind, the waterspout contains several ethereal white human-like spirits spiraling upwards, below her are two old wooden sailing ships being tossed violently in turbulent dark blue waves during a thunderstorm with lightning, dramatic dark clouds fill the sky with a glowing circular portal breaking through the storm, cinematic fantasy scene, dynamic composition, highly detailed
